enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, butter, juice. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off cooker. Transfer eggs to plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Pour juice. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink juice. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Insert laptop. Insert notebook. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Listen to music. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleagues. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Respond to emails. Answer phone calls. Attend staff meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls to community partners. Write reports. Organize files. Print documents. Talk to supervisor. Update calendar. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue working.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Listen to music. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Get snack. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Pick up dishes from sink. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Check social media and news. Watch videos. Close browser. Open document. Type notes. Save document. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime routine and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Breathe deeply. Relax muscles. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Sleep.
